annotations.title: Leaked secret and API key scanner

description: Leaked secret and API key scanner — Scan code, config, logs or a public URL (text= or url=) for leaked credentials: private keys, AWS, Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Discord, Google, SendGrid, npm, Telegram tokens, database URLs with passwords, JWTs, plus high-entropy secret assignments. Returns verdict LEAKED/REVIEW/LOW RISK/CLEAN, findings with type, severity and line number, and rotation advice. Matches are always masked - the full secret is never returned. Offline pattern + entropy engine. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
